svg.title: UMAP
svg.desc: UMAP scatter plot with several irregularly shaped colored clusters, local density variation, and a small legend. Biological basis: UMAP projects high-dimensional neighborhood relationships into a low-dimensional embedding; separated point clouds conventionally denote cell states or clusters.
